0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Chicago Bulls visit the Toronto Raptors, and Chicago lost all three meetings last season, including a 139-109 loss in Chicago on March 18, 2026. For the Bulls, Isaac Okoro, Nic Claxton, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. For the Raptors, Brandon Ingram is out after Achilles surgery, while Chucky Hepburn, Collin Murray-Boyles, Immanuel Quickley, Ja'Kobe Walter, Jakob Poeltl, Jamal Shead, Kawhi Leonard, Nate Bittle, RJ Barrett and Scottie Barnes are day-to-day, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Bulls a 25% chance to win.
